ebm_invoices_source_shape.name: ebm_invoices_source_shape
ebm_invoices_source_shape.value:
("ebm_invoices"."source" = 'booking' AND "ebm_invoices"."booking_id" IS NOT NULL AND "ebm_invoices"."subscription_invoice_id" IS NULL)
          OR ("ebm_invoices"."source" = 'subscription' AND "ebm_invoices"."subscription_invoice_id" IS NOT NULL AND "ebm_invoices"."booking_id" IS NULL)

org_certificates_kind_other_shape.name: org_certificates_kind_other_shape
org_certificates_kind_other_shape.value:
("org_certificates"."kind" = 'other' AND "org_certificates"."kind_other" IS NOT NULL)
          OR ("org_certificates"."kind" <> 'other' AND "org_certificates"."kind_other" IS NULL)

org_registration_reviews_reason_shape.name: org_registration_reviews_reason_shape
org_registration_reviews_reason_shape.value:
("org_registration_reviews"."decision" = 'rejected' AND "org_registration_reviews"."reason_code" IS NOT NULL)
          OR ("org_registration_reviews"."decision" = 'passed' AND "org_registration_reviews"."reason_code" IS NULL)

orgs_domain_shape.name: orgs_domain_shape
orgs_domain_shape.value:
("orgs"."domain" = 'hospitality' AND "orgs"."accommodation_class" IS NOT NULL)
          OR ("orgs"."domain" = 'residence' AND "orgs"."residence_class" IS NOT NULL AND "orgs"."tourism_license_number" IS NULL AND NOT "orgs"."psf_member")

orgs_identifier_shape.name: orgs_identifier_shape
orgs_identifier_shape.value:
("orgs"."domain" = 'hospitality' AND "orgs"."tin" IS NOT NULL)
          OR ("orgs"."domain" = 'residence' AND "orgs"."upi" IS NOT NULL)

orgs_accommodation_class_other_shape.name: orgs_accommodation_class_other_shape
orgs_accommodation_class_other_shape.value:
("orgs"."accommodation_class" = 'other' AND "orgs"."accommodation_class_other" IS NOT NULL)
          OR ("orgs"."accommodation_class" IS DISTINCT FROM 'other' AND "orgs"."accommodation_class_other" IS NULL)

oversight_assignments_scope_shape.name: oversight_assignments_scope_shape
oversight_assignments_scope_shape.value:
("oversight_assignments"."scope_level" = 'country' AND "oversight_assignments"."province_id" IS NULL AND "oversight_assignments"."district_id" IS NULL)
          OR ("oversight_assignments"."scope_level" = 'province' AND "oversight_assignments"."province_id" IS NOT NULL AND "oversight_assignments"."district_id" IS NULL)
          OR ("oversight_assignments"."scope_level" = 'district' AND "oversight_assignments"."district_id" IS NOT NULL)

rate_plans_derivation_shape.name: rate_plans_derivation_shape
rate_plans_derivation_shape.value:
("rate_plans"."parent_rate_plan_id" IS NULL AND "rate_plans"."derivation_kind" IS NULL AND "rate_plans"."derivation_value" IS NULL)
          OR ("rate_plans"."parent_rate_plan_id" IS NOT NULL AND "rate_plans"."derivation_kind" IS NOT NULL AND "rate_plans"."derivation_value" IS NOT NULL)

reviews_side_shape.name: reviews_side_shape
reviews_side_shape.value:
("reviews"."side" = 'guest_to_host')
          OR ("reviews"."cleanliness" IS NULL AND "reviews"."accuracy" IS NULL AND "reviews"."check_in" IS NULL
              AND "reviews"."communication" IS NULL AND "reviews"."location" IS NULL AND "reviews"."value" IS NULL)

subscription_invoices_kind_shape.name: subscription_invoices_kind_shape
subscription_invoices_kind_shape.value:
("subscription_invoices"."invoice_kind" = 'subscription' AND "subscription_invoices"."subscription_id" IS NOT NULL)
          OR ("subscription_invoices"."invoice_kind" = 'registration_fee' AND "subscription_invoices"."subscription_id" IS NULL
              AND "subscription_invoices"."period_start" IS NULL AND "subscription_invoices"."period_end" IS NULL)

threads_scope_exactly_one.name: threads_scope_exactly_one
threads_scope_exactly_one.value:
(CASE WHEN "threads"."booking_id" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
           + CASE WHEN "threads"."guest_stay_id" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
           + CASE WHEN "threads"."lease_id" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1

user_profiles_address_country_shape.name: user_profiles_address_country_shape
user_profiles_address_country_shape.value:
"user_profiles"."country" = 'RW'
          OR ("user_profiles"."district_id" IS NULL AND "user_profiles"."sector_id" IS NULL AND "user_profiles"."village_id" IS NULL)

workspaces_kind_shape.name: workspaces_kind_shape
workspaces_kind_shape.value:
("workspaces"."kind" = 'business' AND "workspaces"."org_id" IS NOT NULL AND "workspaces"."user_id" IS NULL)
          OR ("workspaces"."kind" IN ('broker', 'personal') AND "workspaces"."user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "workspaces"."org_id" IS NULL)
